htmlTitle: How many square metres can you afford in Europe? — a calculator on the TU Wien housing affordability map
metaDescription: Type your net income and see how many square metres you could buy or rent in 8,489 European towns and 1,251 regions, on the data behind the 2026 Journal of Maps study by Sielker and Banabak (TU Wien, ESPON HOUSE4ALL): 22 million listings, 31 countries.
ogDescription: Your income, 8,489 European towns: how many square metres a third of it buys or rents, on the data behind the 2026 TU Wien map of housing affordability.
imageAlt: A choropleth map of Europe by NUTS 3 region in five shades from light to dark, dark where a third of the average income buys fewer than 50 square metres
title: How many square metres can you afford?
ldDescription: An interactive calculator and map built on the ESPON HOUSE4ALL dataset behind Sielker and Banabak (2026), Where can you still afford to live?, Journal of Maps: net income in, affordable square metres out, for 8,489 municipalities and 1,251 NUTS 3 regions in 31 European countries.
ldDatasetName: Housing affordability by European municipality and NUTS 3 region, 2024 listings
ldDatasetDescription: Per-municipality (LAU) sale price and rent per square metre, mean equivalised disposable income 2024, national mortgage rate and the square metres a third of the local mean income buys on a 30-year mortgage or rents, for 89,601 municipalities in 34 countries, extracted from the public ESPON HOUSE4ALL feature service (TU Wien, InAtlas, MCRIT) on 14 September 2026, with degree of urbanisation and coastal flags from the Eurostat LAU 2021 table.
